items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1972-04-05
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Did you know the Landrys that played music back in the old age? >> [INTERVIEWEE] Landry.

ctx.x: Did you know the Landrys that played music back in the old age?
Well they had Osdade Landry who played trombone. I think he played with the Galloway family, you know, happy, loving Galloway. Yeah.
